channel.title: FXStreet Forex & Commodities News
channel.description: Real-time Forex News and the latest trading updates. Stay updated on the latest news about currencies and commodities markets.

item.title: Russian Ruble: CBR credibility risks after cut – Commerzbank
item.description: Commerzbank’s Tatha Ghose reports the Russian central bank cut its key rate to 14.0% despite raising its 2026 inflation forecast and projecting stagflationary macro conditions.

item.title: Federal Reserve: Extended pause but hike risk rising – UOB
item.description: UOB strategists expect the Federal Reserve (Fed) to keep the Fed Funds Target Rate at 3.50%–3.75% at the July Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meeting and maintain a base case of an extended pause through 2026, with easing only in 2Q and 4Q 2027 once transitory inflation fades.

item.title: Oil: Lower prices ease inflation risks – OCBC
item.description: OCBC’s Sim Moh Siong and Christopher Wong note that easing Oil prices, helped by reduced Iran–US tensions, are bringing crude closer to their base case of a gradual downtrend.

item.title: US Dollar: Fed uncertainty tempers USD strength – MUFG
item.description: MUFG’s Lee Hardman notes the US Dollar has softened as Middle East tensions ease and Brent Oil retreats below USD90, reducing energy-driven inflation fears. The correction in energy prices has slightly lowered market-implied odds of a near-term Fed rate hike.

item.title: Gold Price Forecast: XAU/USD is looking for direction around $4,100
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) has been consolidating gains during the European trading session, following a bullish gap at the week’s opening as a moderate improvement of risk sentiment hurt the safe-haven USD.

item.title: EUR/USD Price Forecast: Resumes decline after testing Bearish Flag breakdown
item.description: The Euro (EUR) gives back a majority of its early gains against the US Dollar (USD) after failing to rise above the intraday high of 1.1418 on Monday.

item.title: British Pound: BoE pause risks dovish repricing – ING
item.description: ING’s Francesco Pesole expects the Bank of England (BoE) to leave rates unchanged this week, with a 7–2 vote remaining the base case, although Catherine Mann could join Huw Pill and Megan Greene in supporting a rate hike.

item.title: Euro: Growth and policy doubts point lower against US Dollar – HSBC
item.description: HSBC strategists see EUR/USD at risk of moving lower as the European Central Bank (ECB) maintains a cautious, data-dependent stance and refrains from signalling further rate hikes.

item.title: Gold firms as Oil prices fall on temporary US-Iran pause, Fed in focus
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) opens the week with a bullish gap on Monday as a temporary pause in attacks between the United States (US) and Iran improves risk sentiment and sends Oil prices sharply lower. At the time of writing, XAU/USD is trading around $4,102, up 1.24% on the day.

item.title: Swedish Krona: Moderately firmer tone into year-end – Rabobank
item.description: Rabobank’s Senior FX Strategist Jane Foley notes that benign Consumer Price Index (CPI) and CPIF inflation leave Sweden and the Riksbank better positioned than many G10 peers to delay rate hikes despite supply disruptions from the Iran war.

item.title: Japan PM Takaichi: We must exit from excessively tight fiscal policy
item.description: Japan Prime Minister (PM) Sanae Takaichi said during the European trading session on Monday that the economy needs to exit from fiscal tightness.

item.title: Indian Rupee gains vertically as oil prices sink
item.description: The Indian Rupee (INR) extends its recovery against the US Dollar (USD) at the start of the Federal Reserve’s (Fed) monetary policy week.

item.title: Canadian Dollar holds losses against US Dollar, weighed by lower Oil prices
item.description: The Canadian Dollar (CAD) remains vulnerable, despite the safe-haven US Dollar’s (USD) weakness on Monday, and extends losses for the second consecutive day.

item.title: Australian Dollar advances to 0.7000 as Middle East de-escalation weighs on the USD
item.description: AUD/USD trades around 0.7000 on Monday at the time of writing, up 0.33% on the day, supported by a weaker US Dollar (USD) as geopolitical tensions in the Middle East show signs of easing.

item.title: Japanese Yen: Macro backdrop favors recovery against US Dollar - BBH
item.description: Brown Brothers Harriman’s (BBH) Elias Haddad anticipates the Bank of Japan (BoJ) will leave its policy rate at 1.00% after June’s hike, with inflation still below target and markets pricing only gradual tightening.

item.title: USD/JPY Price Forecast: Eases to 163.50 with the broader bullish trend intact
item.description: The Japanese Yen (JPY) pares recent losses against the US Dollar (USD) on Monday, favoured by a relief rally, as the US and Iran halted their hostilities, opening the door for further negotiations.

item.title: Brent: Market weighs de-escalation signals – ING
item.description: ING analysts Warren Patterson and Ewa Manthey note that Brent has retreated sharply, briefly dropping below US$90/bbl as the US and Iran paused further strikes.

item.title: Silver price today: Silver rises, according to FXStreet data
item.description: Silver prices (XAG/USD) rose on Monday, according to FXStreet data. Silver trades at $59.43 per troy ounce, up 2.26% from the $58.12 it cost on Friday.

item.title: US Dollar: Fed communication key for path – OCBC
item.description: OCBC’s Sim Moh Siong and Christopher Wong highlight that markets have repriced the risk of a July Fed hike higher after Oil-driven inflation worries, but still expect no move.

item.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD rallies near $60 as markets embrace US-Iran de-escalation
item.description: Silver (XAG/USD) rallies on Monday and trades around $59.45 at the time of writing, up 2.27% on the day.

item.title: British Pound: Fiscal risks cap upside against US Dollar – BNY
item.description: Geoff Yu at BNY argues that the Bank of England (BoE) is likely to keep policy unchanged despite energy-driven price pressures, as markets have already tightened financial conditions.

item.title: Gold extends range play below $4,100 as bulls keenly await Fed decision on Wednesday
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) extends its consolidative price move through the first half of the European session on Monday and remains below the $4,100 mark as bulls seem hesitant ahead of the crucial FOMC meeting this week.

item.title: Japanese Yen: BoJ guidance and Fed surprise risk steer the yen – MUFG
item.description: MUFG’s Lee Hardman highlights that lower energy prices have eased pressure on Japanese policymakers and slowed USD/JPY’s climb below 164.00. Markets expect the Bank of Japan (BoJ) to keep rates unchanged but are focused on any hawkish signals on future hikes.

item.title: Australian Dollar: Extended RBA pause may weigh on AUD – BBH
item.description: Brown Brothers Harriman’s (BBH) Elias Haddad sees above-target Australian inflation keeping Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) hike risks alive, with June and Q2 Consumer Price Index (CPI) expected to show firm trimmed mean readings.

item.title: Iran’s Baghaei: Iran has not asked for resumption of talks with the US
item.description: Iran's Foreign Ministry spokesperson Esmail Baghaei said during the European trading session on Monday that mediation efforts by Gulf countries towards the United States (US)-Iran diplomatic solution remain active, but Tehran is not having direct talks with Washington.

item.title: Euro: Energy risks cap recovery against US Dollar – ING
item.description: ING’s Francesco Pesole notes that EUR/USD has rebounded above 1.140 on lower Oil prices but argues the move looks optimistic without a clear de-escalation in geopolitical tensions.

item.title: ECB’s Kazimir: One more interest rate hike is needed
item.description: European Central Bank (ECB) Governing Council member and Governor of the National Bank of Slovakia (NBS), Peter Kazimir, seems to be leaning towards a hawkish monetary policy outlook.

item.title: GBP/USD Price Forecast: VCP breakout likely after Fed-BoE policy announcements
item.description: The British Pound (GBP) is up 0.15% to near 1.3345 against the US Dollar (USD) during the European trading session on Monday.

item.title: Germany’s IFO Business Climate Index improves to 86.6 in July, beats estimates
item.description: The German IFO Institute Business Climate Index improves to 86.6 in July, higher than 86.1 estimates and the June’s reading of 85.7, revised higher from 85.6.

item.title: Indian Rupee: RBI inflow measures support against US Dollar – Commerzbank
item.description: Commerzbank analysts report that USD/INR was little changed near 96.57 on Friday but has edged higher since early July, largely reflecting renewed upward pressure from Oil prices. They argue that the recent pullback in Oil should ease some strain on the Rupee.
